resources.string: To use the clock as an always-on screen, set it as the system screen saver. The clock then appears automatically whenever the phone is idle and charging or docked, and goes away as soon as you touch the screen.
If “AlwaysON clock” is not listed, first turn the screen saver on, then pick it and set the start condition to “While charging”.

On Android the always-on-clock behaviour is provided by the system screen saver, because there is no public API to draw on the screen while it is fully off. This app registers a screen saver with a pure black, OLED-friendly background; only the clock text is dimmable.
